description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Order made under Section 326 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance which is the Chapter 252 that should be read in Conjunction with Section 2 of the Provincial Councils and (Chapter 252) Municipal Councils Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal and regulatory matters concerning municipal governance. It references specific ordinances (Municipal Councils Ordinance Chapter 252) and acts (Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, Local Authorities (Special Provisions) Act), outlines legal procedures for budget approval, specifies consequences for non-compliance (deemed vacancy of Mayor position), and delegates powers and functions according to statutory provisions. While it mentions government officials (Governor, Mayor, Deputy Mayor), the core content focuses on legal frameworks, regulatory procedures, and statutory interpretations rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
